mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.am.ApiMngMapper.select.selectStndApiInfo (표준API단건조회) */ API_VER_SN /* API버전일련번호 */ ,API_ID /* API아이디 */ ,API_NM /* API명 */ ,SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD /* SAAS공형태코드 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD) AS SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_NM /* SAAS제공형태코드명 */ ,API_DMND_RSPNS_SE_CD /* API요청응답구분코드 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(API_DMND_RSPNS_SE_CD) AS API_DMND_RSPNS_SE_NM /* API요청응답구분코드명 */ ,HTTP_CMNC_SE_CD /* HTTP통신구분코드 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(HTTP_CMNC_SE_CD) AS HTTP_CMNC_SE_NM /* HTTP통신구분코드명 */ ,URI_ADDR /* URI주소 */ ,FRST_CRT_PRCR_ID /* 최초생성처리자아이디 */ ,FRST_CRT_DT /* 최초생성일시 */ ,LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID /* 최종변경처리자아이디 */ ,CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDCT_API_CMNCRSLT_L R LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M G ON G.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = R.SAAS_PRDCT_ID WHERE R.API_ID = S.API_ID AND R.API_VER_SN = S.API_VER_SN AND G.SAAS_PRDCT_API_VER_SN = S.API_VER_SN AND G.GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN = 'Y' /* AND R.CMNC_RSLT_CD = 'A0050002' */ AND R.SRVR_SE_CD = 'A0060002' )THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN /* 카탈로그 등록여부 */ , CASE WHEN S.API_VER_SN < ( SELECT MAX(API_VER_SN) FROM USCM.TBCM_STD_API_M )THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS LAST_VER_EDIT_YN /* 최신버전수정가능여부 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_STD_API_M S WHERE S.API_ID = #{apiId} AND S.API_VER_SN = #{apiVerSn} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.am.ApiMngMapper.select.selectStndApiArtclList (표준API항목조회) */ L.API_VER_SN /* API버전일련번호 */ ,L.API_ID /* API아이디 */ ,API_ARTCL_SE_CD /* API항목구분코드 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(API_ARTCL_SE_CD) AS API_ARTCL_SE_NM /* API항목구분코드명 */ ,API_ARTCL_SN /* API항목일련번호 */ ,API_ARTCL_ATRB_NM /* API항목속성명 */ ,API_ARTCL_DATA_TYPE_CD /* API항목유형코드 */ ,USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(API_ARTCL_DATA_TYPE_CD) AS API_ARTCL_DATA_TYPE_NM /* API항목유형코드명 */ ,API_ARTCL_ESNTL_YN /* API항목필수여부 */ ,API_ARTCL_CN /* API항목내용 */ ,L.FRST_CRT_PRCR_ID /* 최초생성처리자아이디 */ ,L.FRST_CRT_DT /* 최초생성일시 */ ,L.LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID /* 최종변경처리자아이디 */ ,L.LAST_CHG_DT /* 최종변경일시 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_STD_API_ARTCL_L L JOIN USCM.TBCM_STD_API_M S ON S.API_ID = L.API_ID AND S.API_VER_SN = L.API_VER_SN WHERE L.API_ID = #{apiId} AND L.API_VER_SN = #{apiVerSn} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY L.API_ARTCL_SE_CD, L.API_ARTCL_SN
mapper.update: UPDATE /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.am.ApiMngMapper.update.updateStndApi (표준API수정_API기본정보) */ USCM.TBCM_STD_API_M SET API_NM = #{apiNm} /* API명 */ ,SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD = #{saasPrdctTypeCd} /* SAAS제품유형코드 */ ,API_DMND_RSPNS_SE_CD = #{apiDmndRspnsSeCd} /* API요청응답구분코드 */ ,HTTP_CMNC_SE_CD = #{httpCmncSeCd} /* HTTP통신구분코드 */ ,URI_ADDR = #{uriAddr} /* URI주소 */ ,LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID = #{lastChgPrcrId} /* 최종변경처리자아이디 */ ,LAST_CHG_DT = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') /* 최종변경일시 */ WHERE API_ID = #{apiId} AND API_VER_SN = #{apiVerSn}
mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.am.ApiMngMapper.select.selectNextStndApiVer (표준API_최대버전+1값조회) */ COALESCE(MAX(API_VER_SN), 0) + 1 AS next_ver FROM USCM.TBCM_API_VER_B
SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.am.ApiMngMapper.select.selectStndApiVerList (표준API_버전정보조회) */ API_VER_SN /* API버전일련번호 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_API_VER_B WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY API_VER_SN ASC

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.am.ApiMngMapper.select.selectStndApiNmCnt (표준API명_중복검사용조회) */ CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 AND MIN(API_ID) = #{apiId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM USCM.TBCM_STD_API_M WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND API_NM = #{apiNm} AND API_VER_SN = #{apiVerSn}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.am.ApiMngMapper.select.selectStndApiUriCnt (표준APIURI_중복검사용조회) */ CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 AND MIN(API_ID) = #{apiId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM USCM.TBCM_STD_API_M WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND URI_ADDR = #{uriAddr} AND API_VER_SN = #{apiVerSn}
mapper.update: UPDATE /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.am.ApiMngMapper.update.updateProdApiVer (상품API버전수정) */ USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M SET SAAS_PRDCT_API_VER_SN = #{apiVerSn} WHERE SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId} AND GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN = 'N' AND (SAAS_PRDCT_API_VER_SN IS NULL OR SAAS_PRDCT_API_VER_SN <> #{apiVerSn})
mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.pm.ApiMngMapper.select.selectMaxStndApiVer -- API 최종버전 조회 */ MAX(API_VER_SN) /* api 버전일련번호 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_API_VER_B WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' /* 사용여부 */

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.pm.ApiMngMapper.select.selectProdListForDelete (0924 상품아이디조회_api삭제용) */ G.SAAS_PRDCT_ID FROM USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M G WHERE G.USE_YN = 'Y' AND G.SAAS_PRDCT_API_VER_SN = #{apiVerSn} AND G.GDS_GDNTC_REG_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDCT_API_CMNCRSLT_L R WHERE R.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = G.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AND R.API_ID = #{apiId} AND R.API_VER_SN = #{apiVerSn} AND R.SRVR_SE_CD = 'A0060002' )
mapper.update: UPDATE /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.pm.ApiMngMapper.update.updateCertKey (0924 상품인증관리내역수정_api삭제용) */ USCM.TBCM_CMNC_MNG_L M SET API_CMNC_SCS_YN = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDCT_API_CMNCRSLT_L R1 WHERE R1.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = M.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AND R1.SRVR_SE_CD = M.SRVR_SE_CD AND R1.API_VER_SN = #{apiVerSn} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDCT_API_CMNCRSLT_L R2 WHERE R2.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = M.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AND R2.SRVR_SE_CD = M.SRVR_SE_CD AND R2.API_VER_SN = #{apiVerSn} AND R2.CMNC_RSLT_CD != 'A0050002' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END , LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID = #{lastChgPrcrId} , LAST_CHG_DT = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE M.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId} AND M.SRVR_SE_CD = 'A0060002'
